name: rail_groove_front
_why: the front joining groove must be clear from its floor all the way out of the top of the side wall, or a neighbouring module's rail cannot be lowered into it

name: rail_groove_back
_why: same for the back groove; this one runs past the tier B rim, which is where the buttress had to stop short

name: outlet_bay1_tierA
_why: the pill path: from inside pick tray 1, under the hopper front wall, into the hopper above the ramp. If anything ever closes this the bays simply stop feeding.

name: outlet_bay5_tierB
_why: the same path on the far tier and the far bay -- the bay nearest the right-hand rail buttress
